responsibility: Defines M68k inline-assembly register classes and registers, distinguishing general, address, and data registers, enforcing reserved-register restrictions, and exposing the emitted register spelling for valid operands.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `abi/call/m68k.rs`, this M68k file defines inline `asm!` register classes and concrete registers, distinguishing data vs address registers and rejecting reserved ones, rather than controlling how call arguments and returns are passed.
